lines.t: [hook]Will it *get there*?
Four hearts, | two cards to come: | [pct0]*thirty-six* percent.
Here's how you know that | in *two seconds*, | every time.
[count]Start with the deck: | thirteen hearts in it.
You can already see [seen]*four* of them,
which leaves [nine]*nine* | that can still save you. | Nine outs.
[flop]Now, on the flop, | with two cards to come,
just take your outs | and [x4]multiply by *four*.
Nine times four | is [r36]*thirty-six* percent,
so roughly | one time in three.
[turn]But say the turn | is a blank.
One card left now, | so it's outs [x2]times *two*:
[r18]*eighteen* percent.
[exact]And how close is that | to the truth?
The exact numbers are | [e35]*thirty-five* | and [e19]*nineteen*.
Off by one, | either way.
Which is plenty good enough | to decide in *two seconds*.
[sheet]So save this | for the common draws:
[d4]a gutshot, | four outs.
[d6]Two overcards, | six.
[d8]Open-ended, | eight.
[d9]Your flush draw, | nine.
[d12]Flush draw with a pair, | twelve.
And [d15]flush and straight draw together, | fifteen.
Then send this to the friend | who chases every *gutshot*.
[outro]So, which draw do *you* chase?
Wrong answers in the comments,
and [cta]run any spot free | at llama poker dot com.
